newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks mixed, LVMH sells Guinness shares.
newsitem.headline: French stocks mixed, LVMH sells Guinness shares.

text.p: French shares opened, slipped back somewhat, and recovered its gains with LVMH making a big jump as traders said it was selling 135 million shares in Guinness Plc for around 414p per share.

Market sources said that LVMH, up 4.53 percent at 1,570, was selling Guinness shares in the market through Goldman Sachs in an operation which would reduce its stake to 15 percent from 21. LVMH had no comment.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 0.2 points or 4.77 percent at 2,412.54 at 0910 GMT.
